plain: Between September 1966 and March 1967, the story goes, US Air Force nuclear missile bases lost 30 missiles to UFO activity, meaning the weapons were knocked out of action while strange objects were around. If true, unknown craft were able to switch off part of America's nuclear force. Robert Salas, a former Air Force officer, tells it in the same words in two episodes: "we lost 30 missiles to UFO activity." In one he names Minot and Malmstrom Air Force Bases. In the other, an episode where he speaks as someone who was there, he places the losses at Malmstrom. Michels repeats the same figure in a separate episode. He credits the researcher Bob Hastings and his book UFOs and Nukes. So the account comes from a man who served at the bases and from a host passing on a researcher's work.
